about_the_game:
Lysward is in development, and we’re excited to share the journey with you. Wishlist now to stay updated on the latest improvements.

In Lysward, you’ll find yourself stranded in this harsh environment after escaping the experimental facility that was your home and prison. Now, survival hinges on your resourcefulness and ability to adapt.

Umbra is a tidally locked world split between perpetual daylight and eternal darkness. Your story unfolds on Zenit, where the sun always shines, its light generating Amri— a potent magical resource that empowers individuals to shape reality through intent. However, this power is double-edged, as overexposure leads to corruption.

You must navigate this treacherous desert where the sun’s relentless heat can defeat you quickly, and search for the remnants of the advanced technology left by ancient civilizations. Unravel the mysteries of this forlorn place and find a way to survive.

Survival in Lysward depends on your resourcefulness. Scavenge for resources, craft vital tools and equipment, and carefully manage your inventory—with items of varying sizes and shapes. Every decision counts in this unforgiving environment.


The energy flowing through your Amri device is more than just a tool—it’s the key to your survival. Master its power to overcome the challenges of this unforgiving world. Whether you’re facing scorching heat, treacherous terrain, or mysterious foes, the Amri magic will be your greatest ally. But beware: only those who truly understand its potential will thrive. Will you rise to the challenge and unlock the secrets of the Amri?


Explore the desert with your Speeder, a small but fast vehicle that’s not just your ride across the sands, but also a mobile base of operations for you and your companion. While it offers heat protection, the Speeder can be damaged and will require repairs.

The visuals of the Speeder are still a work in progress.


Work together with your companion to conquer the harsh elements, unravel the secrets of the desert, and uncover the mysteries of a long-lost civilization.

The desert is alive with strange creatures roaming the sands. Some are friendly, offering resources or shelter from the scorching sun, while others will attack. Learn their behaviors and adapt your strategies to survive encounters with the desert’s inhabitants.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-13700 / AMD Ryzen 7 7700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: Lysward is a single-player survival adventure set in a vast and unforgiving desert in the fantastical world of Umbra. Explore, craft, team up with your companion, and leverage the Amri magic to endure the heat.
